venue.name: Multiple Cities
venue.details: See the locations tab for more information about venue locations

information: This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, New Mexico, Montana, Utah, and Wyoming are elligible to win the title of Rocky Mountain Champion. **Please read all information on the [Locations and Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RockyMountainFMCChampionship2024#34353-locations-and-registration-instructions) before registration** **Payment process for this competition is different: you will click on the appropriate link for your location. Please pay attention to all detail to ensure your registration is accepted without issue. Use the contact form for any questions.** Go to our [link tree](https://linktr.ee/utahcubing) to find links to our Facebook group, Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
